response.sql: WITH cust AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS spent FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), tot AS (SELECT SUM(spent) AS overall FROM cust), shares AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, c.spent, c.spent * 1.0 / t.overall AS share FROM cust c, tot t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.* FROM shares s, avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_s) SELECT AVG(above.spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(above.share) AS avg_share, AVG(above.share - a.avg_s) AS avg_beat FROM above, avg_share a;
